ja-JP.description: 文化体系の視点から対象や問題群の本質構造を捉え直し、発見を問い・比較・構成へ具体化します。材料統合と継続管理は別スキルへ接続します。

en-US.description: Reinterpret essential structures through cultural perspectives and turn discoveries into questions, comparisons, and compositions. Material synthesis and continuation connect to separate skills.
